scientific_integrity: Claims, counts and orbit classification were checked using full-domain enumeration by both direct infection and an independent three-core peeling algorithm. Source texts and published claim summaries were compared; no unrestricted novelty certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification at four-neighbor threshold on only the Shrikhande and 4-by-4 rook graphs. The general infection/core-peeling equivalence and the minimum rook six-seed bound are previously known. Census is finite-exhaustive and reproducible using two stand-alone implementations; it is not externally certified. Unindexed historical tables remain a priority risk.
title: A unique seven-seed orbit separates threshold-four contagion on two cospectral graphs
